criteria.text: The participant has histologically confirmed solid tumors that have progressed on standard therapy known to prolong survival or for which no standard treatment options exist
The participant has histologically confirmed myelodysplastic syndrome that has progressed on standard therapy or for which no standard treatment options exist
The participant is greater than or equal to 18 years of age
The participant has an ECOG performance status less than or equal to 2
The participant has a life expectancy of greater than 3 months
The participant has an absolute neutrophil count greater than or equal to 1,500/mcL
The participant has a platelet count greater than or equal to 100,000/mcL

The participant has a total bilirubin level less than or equal to 1.5 times the institutional upper limit of normal (or less than or equal to 3 times the upper limit of normal in the presence of documented Gilbert's syndrome or liver metastases at baseline)
The participant has an AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT) level less than or equal to 3 times the institutional upper limit of normal
The participant has a creatinine level less than or equal to 1.5 times the institutional upper limit of normal
The participant has a creatinine clearance greater than or equal to 60 mL/min/1.73 m2
The participant agrees to use adequate contraception prior to study entry, for the duration of study participation, and for at least 3 months after dosing with study drugs ceases
The participant agrees to use adequate contraception prior to the study, for the duration of study participation, and 3 months after completion of study drug administration
The participant has completed any chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or biologic therapy at least 3 weeks (or at least 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter) prior to entering the study
The participant has had at least 2 weeks since any prior administration of a study drug in a Phase 0 or equivalent study and at least 1 week from palliative radiation therapy
The participant has recovered to eligibility levels from prior toxicity or adverse events
The participant has a tumor amenable to biopsy and is willing to undergo tumor biopsies
The participant has sensory/motor neuropathy greater than or equal to Grade 2
The participant has a QTc interval greater than 450 msec for men or greater than 470 msec for women at study entry, or has a history of congenital long QT syndrome
The participant is receiving any other investigational agents
The participant has active brain metastases, CNS disease, or carcinomatous meningitis
The participant has a history of allergic reactions attributed to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to study drugs
The participant has previously received either clofarabine or bortezomib

The participant has an uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, serious untreated infection, symptomatic respiratory failure/congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, or psychiatric illness/social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements
The participant is a pregnant woman

The participant is a nursing woman who has discontinued breastfeeding prior to the first dose of study drug and refrains from nursing throughout the treatment period and for 3 months following the last dose of study drug
The participant is an HIV-positive patient on combination antiretroviral therapy
The participant is a man or woman of any race or ethnic group

P1.text: Histologically confirmed solid tumors that have progressed on standard therapy known to prolong survival or for which no standard treatment options exist, or

P2.text: histologically confirmed myelodysplastic syndrome that has progressed on standard therapy or for which no standard treatment options exist.

P3.text: Age greater than or equal to18 years.

P4.text: ECOG performance status less than or equal to 2.

P5.text: Life expectancy of greater than 3 months

P6.text: Absolute neutrophil count: greater than or equal to 1,500/mcL for solid tumors and lymphomas only

P7.text: Platelets: greater than or equal to 100,000/mcL for solid tumors and lymphomas only

P8.text: Total bilirubin: less than or equal to 1.5 X institutional ULN (\<=3 x upper limit of normal in the presence of documented Gilbert's syndrome or liver metastases at baseline)

P9.text: AST(SGOT)/ALT(SGPT): less than or equal to 3 X institutional upper limit of normal

P10.text: creatinine: ess than or equal to 1.5 X institutional ULN

P11.text: creatinine clearance greater than or equal to 60 mL/min/1.73 m2 for patients with creatinine levels \>1.5 mg/dL

P12.text: women of child-bearing potential and men must agree to use adequate contraception (hormonal or barrier method of birth control; abstinence) prior to study entry and for the duration of study participation and for at least 3 months after dosing with study drugs ceases.

P13.text: Men treated or enrolled on this protocol must also agree to use adequate contraception prior to the study, for the duration of study participation, and 3 months after completion of study drug administration.

P14.text: Patients must have completed any chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or biologic therapy \>= 3 weeks (or \>= 5 half-lives, whichever is shorter) prior to entering the study.

P15.text: Patients must be \>= 2 weeks since any prior administration of a study drug in a Phase 0 or equivalent study and be \>= 1 week from palliative radiation therapy

P16.text: Patients must have recovered to eligibility levels from prior toxicity or adverse events.

P17.text: For patients enrolled on the expansion cohort, patients must have tumor amenable to biopsy (excisional or incision biopsies of skin or H \& N lesions under visualization) and willingness to undergo tumor biopsies.

P19.text: QTc interval (Fridericia formula) \> 450 msec for men or \> 470 msec for women at study entry; history of congenital long QT syndrome

P20.text: Patients who are receiving any other investigational agents.

P21.text: Patients with active brain metastases, CNS disease, or carcinomatous meningitis are excluded from this clinical trial.

P22.text: History of allergic reactions attributed to compounds of similar chemical or biologic composition to study drugs.

P23.text: Patients who have previously received either clofarabine or bortezomib will be excluded as this may affect accurate determination of the MTD.

P24.text: Uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, serious untreated infection, symptomatic respiratory failure/congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, cardiac arrhythmia, or psychiatric illness/social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements.

P25.text: Pregnant women are excluded from this study because bortezomib and clofarabine have been assigned to pregnancy category D by the FDA.

P26.text: Because there is an unknown but potential risk for adverse events in nursing infants secondary to treatment of the mother with the study drugs, breastfeeding should be discontinued prior to the first dose of study drug and women should refrain from nursing throughout the treatment period and for 3 months following the last dose of study drug.

P27.text: HIV-positive patients on combination antiretroviral therapy are ineligible because of possible pharmacokinetic interactions with study drugs.

P28.text: Both men and women of all races and ethnic groups are eligible for this trial.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: These questions are about the trial "Trial of the Combination of Bortezomib and Clofarabine in Adults With Relapsed Solid Tumors". I'll ask about the rest of its rules one at a time. You can skip any question, and "I don't know" is always fine.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you been diagnosed with a solid tumor that has grown or spread despite standard treatment, or for which no standard options are available?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, my melanoma has come back multiple times despite surgery and immunotherapy treatments like pembrolizumab and nivolumab with ipilimumab.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you have a biopsy report confirming that your melanoma is a solid tumor?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have a specific biopsy report confirming it is a solid tumor. I know it came back and I had surgery to remove lymph nodes and spots, but I don't have details on the pathology reports.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you ever been diagnosed with myelodysplastic syndrome (a type of blood disorder) that has progressed or has no standard treatment options?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have myelodysplastic syndrome. The text only mentions melanoma, prostate cancer, high blood pressure, and high cholesterol.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To confirm, are you 18 years of age or older?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: Yes, I am 80 years old.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. On a scale of 0 to 5, how would you rate your ability to carry out daily activities? An ECOG score of 2 means you are able to care for yourself but are unable to carry out any work activities, and are up and about more than 50% of waking hours.

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I would rate my ability to carry out daily activities as a 2. I can care for myself and do light work, but heavy things tire me out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Based on your current health, do you expect to live for more than 3 months?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I expect to live for more than 3 months. I haven't been given a prognosis or timeline by my doctors.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently using adequate contraception, and are you willing to continue using it during the study and for at least 3 months after your last dose of study drugs?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know about contraception. I am 80 years old and had my prostate removed, so I am not sexually active or capable of pregnancy.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. When was the last time you received chemotherapy, radiation therapy, or biologic therapy?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know the exact date of my last treatment. I finished pembrolizumab about a year after my second surgery, and then had nivolumab with ipilimumab after my lymph nodes were removed last summer.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you received any chemotherapy, radiation, or biologic therapy in the last 2 weeks?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I haven't received any chemotherapy, radiation, or biologic therapy in the last 2 weeks. My last treatments were nivolumab with ipilimumab after my lymph nodes were removed last summer.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Have you recovered from any side effects or health issues caused by your previous cancer treatments?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have fully recovered from all side effects. I can do light work, but heavy things still tire me out.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you willing to have a tumor biopsy (a small tissue sample taken for testing) during this study?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I am willing to have a tumor biopsy. I haven't discussed this specific requirement with my doctors yet.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have nerve damage symptoms like numbness, tingling, or weakness in your hands or feet that interfere with daily activities?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have nerve damage symptoms like numbness or tingling. The text doesn't mention any such issues.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with a heart rhythm condition called long QT syndrome, or has a recent ECG shown a prolonged QTc interval?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have long QT syndrome or if my ECG shows a prolonged QTc interval. The text doesn't mention any heart rhythm conditions or recent ECG results.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you currently receiving any other investigational agents (experimental drugs or treatments not yet approved for general use)?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I am not currently receiving any other investigational agents or experimental treatments.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with cancer that has spread to your brain, central nervous system, or the fluid around your brain and spine?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if my cancer has spread to my brain or central nervous system. The text only mentions spots in my liver and on the skin of my right neck.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever had an allergic reaction to bortezomib or clofarabine, or to other medicines with a similar chemical makeup?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have no allergies, so I haven't had any reactions to those medicines.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever received treatment with bortezomib or clofarabine before?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: No, I have never received treatment with bortezomib or clofarabine before. I have only had surgery, pembrolizumab, and nivolumab with ipilimumab.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Do you currently have any serious untreated infections, heart or lung problems, or other medical conditions that are not well-controlled?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I have high blood pressure and high cholesterol, but I don't know if they are considered 'not well-controlled' or if I have other serious untreated heart or lung problems. The text doesn't mention any active infections or other uncontrolled conditions.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. To help us decide, are your high blood pressure and cholesterol currently managed with medication and stable, or are they causing symptoms or requiring frequent changes in treatment?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if my high blood pressure and cholesterol are currently managed with medication or if they are stable. The text doesn't say how they are being treated.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Have you ever been diagnosed with HIV or are you currently taking medication for HIV?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I don't know if I have HIV or take medication for it. The text doesn't mention anything about HIV.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thanks. Are you a man or a woman?

transcript.speaker: participant
transcript.text: I am a man. I had my prostate removed, which confirms my gender.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Thank you, that's all my questions. Your record for this trial is ready, for you and your oncologist. They and the trial team decide whether it is right for you.
